notes: The unseen chanters are two neighbours standing beyond the fence mark of the village backdrop; his wondering becomes his own line.
title: Тринадцать

lines.text: Идёт мужик мимо забора и слышит, как на той стороне несколько человек кричат:
Тринадцать, тринадцать, тринадцать!
Интересно, что они там делают?
Через пару шагов в заборе дырка, и он в неё заглядывает. В этот момент с той стороны ему тычут пальцем в глаз, и люди кричат:
Четырнадцать, четырнадцать, четырнадцать!

notes: The unseen chanters are two neighbours standing beyond the fence mark of the village backdrop; his wondering becomes his own line.
title: Thirteen

lines.text: A man is walking past a fence and hears a few people on the other side shouting:
Thirteen, thirteen, thirteen!
I wonder what they're doing.
A few steps further there's a hole in the fence, and he looks through it. At that moment a finger pokes him in the eye from the other side, and the people shout:
Fourteen, fourteen, fourteen!

notes: Dinner moved to the kitchen table; the girlfriend is on screen silently, the dog sits by the father. Typos fixed; 'scheißt' softened to 'kackt'.
title: Hasso!

lines.text: Der Freund ist das erste Mal bei den Eltern seiner Freundin.
Nach dem Essen verspürt er den unausweichlichen Drang zum... Furzen. Leise, aber hörbar lässt er dann einen fahren.
Hasso!
Puh. Der Alte denkt, dass es der Hund war.
Und prompt lässt er noch einen fahren.
Hasso!
Darauf folgt noch einer, aber ein verdammt lauter.
Hasso! Geh weg, bevor der Typ dir noch auf den Kopf kackt!
lines.uncensored: Hasso! Geh weg, bevor der Typ dir noch auf den Kopf scheißt!

notes: Dog name Hasso localised to the familiar Russian Sharik; dinner at the kitchen table, girlfriend silent on screen. 'насрал' softened to 'нагадил'.
title: Шарик!

lines.text: Парень впервые в гостях у родителей своей девушки.
После ужина его охватывает неодолимое желание... пукнуть. Тихо, но слышно, он пукает.
Шарик!
Фух. Старик думает, что это собака.
И тут же пукает ещё раз.
Шарик!
Следом ещё один, но чертовски громкий.
Шарик! Уйди, пока этот тип тебе на голову не нагадил!
lines.uncensored: Шарик! Уйди, пока этот тип тебе на голову не насрал!

notes: Dog name Hasso localised to Rex; dinner at the kitchen table, girlfriend silent on screen. 'shits' softened to 'craps'.
title: Rex!

lines.text: The boyfriend is at his girlfriend's parents' place for the first time.
After dinner he feels the unavoidable urge to... fart. Quietly, but audibly, he lets one go.
Rex!
Phew. The old man thinks it was the dog.
And promptly he lets another one go.
Rex!
Then comes another one, but a damn loud one.
Rex! Get away before this guy craps on your head!
lines.uncensored: Rex! Get away before this guy shits on your head!

notes: Pure dialogue, kept word for word; no narrator needed.
title: Telefon

lines.text: Erzählen Sie mir nun, wie Sie sich die Ohren verbrannt haben.
Ich habe gebügelt, als das Telefon klingelte, und habe mir das Bügeleisen ans Ohr gehalten.
Aber Sie haben sich beide Ohren verbrannt!
Das liegt daran, dass ich sofort den Notruf wählen wollte.

notes: Line-by-line translation; Notruf becomes calling an ambulance.
title: Телефон

lines.text: А теперь расскажите мне, как вы обожгли себе уши.
Я гладил, когда зазвонил телефон, и приложил утюг к уху.
Но вы же обожгли оба уха!
Это потому, что я сразу хотел позвонить в скорую.

notes: Line-by-line translation; Notruf becomes calling an ambulance.
title: The Phone

lines.text: Now tell me how you burned your ears.
I was ironing when the phone rang, and I held the iron to my ear.
But you burned both ears!
That's because I wanted to call an ambulance right away.

notes: Klaus strolls in; the hated neighbour is the grandma puppet in a headscarf. 'Er ruft ihr zu' cut, the picture shows it. Broom requested from art.
title: Nachbarn

needs.description: a witch-style besom broom held in the hand and beaten against the ground
needs.why: the punchline treats her broom as a witch's vehicle that won't start

lines.text: Klaus spaziert durch die Nachbarschaft, als er seine verhasste Nachbarin sieht, wie sie vor der Garage lange und heftig ihren Besen ausklopft.
Na, Frau Meier, springt er wieder nicht an?

notes: Frau Meier localised to the natural Russian address 'Петровна'; Klaus left unnamed as 'мужик'. Broom requested from art.
title: Соседи

needs.description: a witch-style besom broom held in the hand and beaten against the ground
needs.why: the punchline treats her broom as a witch's vehicle that won't start

lines.text: Мужик гуляет по району и видит, как его ненавистная соседка перед гаражом долго и яростно выколачивает свою метлу.
Ну что, Петровна, опять не заводится?

notes: Klaus becomes the puppet's English name Bob, Frau Meier becomes Mrs. Miller. Broom requested from art.
title: Neighbors

needs.description: a witch-style besom broom held in the hand and beaten against the ground
needs.why: the punchline treats her broom as a witch's vehicle that won't start

lines.text: Bob is strolling through the neighborhood when he sees his hated neighbor in front of her garage, beating her broom long and hard.
Well, Mrs. Miller, won't it start again?

notes: The nurse rushes in on her line; 'Kommt die Krankenschwester zum Arzt' is shown, not narrated.
title: Der Hypochonder

lines.text: Herr Doktor, Herr Doktor! Der Hypochonder aus Zimmer drei ist gestorben.
Also jetzt übertreibt er aber wirklich!

notes: The nurse rushes in on her line; translated line by line.
title: Ипохондрик

lines.text: Доктор, доктор! Ипохондрик из третьей палаты умер.
Ну, вот это он уже точно преувеличивает!

notes: The nurse rushes in on her line; translated line by line.
title: The Hypochondriac

lines.text: Doctor, doctor! The hypochondriac in room three has died.
Well, now he's really overdoing it!

notes: Two managers: the boss and the neighbour puppet dressed as a manager with badge and tie (no nachalnik double). Typo 'wei' fixed to 'zwei'.
title: Kassiererin gesucht

lines.text: Unterhalten sich zwei Supermarkt-Leiter.
Und, wie läuft's bei euch so?
Ach, immer nur Ärger mit dem Personal, wir suchen mal wieder eine Kassiererin!
Aber ihr habt doch letztens erst eine Neue eingestellt?
Ja. Genau die suchen wir ja!

notes: 'Ищем кассиршу' keeps both meanings, so the punch survives literally. Second manager is the neighbour puppet with badge and tie.
title: Ищем кассиршу

lines.text: Разговаривают два директора супермаркетов.
Ну, как у вас дела?
Ох, одни проблемы с персоналом, опять ищем кассиршу!
Так вы же недавно новую взяли?
Да. Вот её-то мы и ищем!

notes: 'Looking for a cashier' keeps both meanings, so the punch survives literally. Second manager is the neighbour puppet with badge and tie.
title: Cashier Wanted

lines.text: Two supermarket managers are chatting.
So, how are things at your place?
Oh, nothing but trouble with the staff. We're looking for a cashier again!
But didn't you just hire a new one?
Yes. She's exactly the one we're looking for!

notes: Two psychics: the young guy in a turban and the grandma puppet as a fortune teller with headscarf and earrings.
title: Zwei Hellseher

lines.text: Treffen sich zwei Hellseher. Sagt der eine:
Dir geht's gut. Und mir?

notes: Two psychics: the young guy in a turban and the grandma puppet as a fortune teller with headscarf and earrings.
title: Два экстрасенса

lines.text: Встречаются два экстрасенса. Один говорит:
У тебя всё хорошо. А у меня?

notes: Two psychics: the young guy in a turban and the grandma puppet as a fortune teller with headscarf and earrings.
title: Two Psychics

lines.text: Two psychics meet. One of them says:
You're fine. How am I?
